objective: Add no-native PTT voice-to-text and in-channel text conversation without changing floor arbitration
productionBaselineEvidence: Production OTA has not been independently fingerprint-verified for this task; main base SHA 355f41e8065e48e599544bfd8cdf860760f7e49f is GitHub's exact source at branch creation, not verified production. New Supabase table RLS and caption controller deployment independently checked; no app OTA published.
chosenApproach: Use existing Stream PTT call closed-caption events with per-member opt-in, server-authenticated channel caption control and membership-scoped Supabase text/caption table; preserve mic/floor/native modules.
selectionRationale: No native SDK changes, isolated backend and UI, channel-specific storage, supports actual realtime messages and avoids new parallel audio recording.
alternativeApproaches: Record PTT audio in a second native module and send to an external speech-to-text service (rejected: native rebuild and mic contention)
Use Stream server-side closed captions with an authenticated controller and existing Stream call (chosen)
Store text in existing Connect chat (rejected: loses CH01–CH10 conversation isolation)
acceptanceChecks: Live PTT hold/release floor remains unchanged
Text messages insert and stream only to active members of matching scope and channel
Caption listener only attributes sender's own opted-in speech to an active/recent floor transmission
No app.config.js, native project, or new package dependency changes
Database policy regression and targeted Node contract tests pass
Client typecheck and actual Stream captioning pass before consolidation OTA
preserveBehaviors: PTT priority/SOS preemption and floor allocation
PTT AdMob banner and existing routing
